sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: On the 17th of May 2008, motorway patrol officers Cope and Finlayson responded to a call that a pedestrian had been hit by a vehicle on the M6 motorway,
sentences.zh: 2008年5月17日，高速公路巡警科普（Cope）和芬莱森（Finlayson）接到报警，称在M6高速公路上有一名行人被车撞倒，

sentences.en: near the city of Stoke-on-Trent in England.
sentences.zh: 地点位于英国斯托克城（Stoke-on-Trent）附近。

sentences.en: Expecting the worst, the two officers were surprised when they arrived on scene to see two pedestrians standing calmly and uninjured on the shoulder of the motorway.
sentences.zh: 两名警官本以为会看到惨状，但抵达现场后却惊讶地发现，有两名行人正平静地站在高速公路的路肩上，并未受伤。

sentences.en: It didn't look like much was going on at all.
sentences.zh: 现场看起来似乎什么事都没发生。

sentences.en: But within a few minutes, the seemingly calm situation took a frightening twiSt.
sentences.zh: 但几分钟内，这看似平静的局面却发生了令人惊恐的转折。

sentences.en: Hardly anything is known about the lives of twin sisters Sabina and Ursula Eriksson.
sentences.zh: 关于双胞胎姐妹萨比娜（Sabina）和厄休拉·埃里克森（Ursula Eriksson）的生活，外界知之甚少。

sentences.en: They were born in Sweden on the 3rd of November 1967.
sentences.zh: 她们于1967年11月3日出生在瑞典。

sentences.en: They have an older sister Mona and an older brother Bjorn.
sentences.zh: 她们还有一个姐姐莫娜（Mona）和一个哥哥比约恩（Bjorn）。

sentences.en: Whilst at school, the twins were described by some as a little bit odd.
sentences.zh: 在校期间，一些人形容这对双胞胎有点古怪。

sentences.en: They kept mostly to themselves and at times they had a tendency to be violent.
sentences.zh: 她们大多时候独来独往，有时还有暴力倾向。

sentences.en: We know that in the year 2000, Ursula was living in the United States and Sabina was living in Ireland with her partner and two children.
sentences.zh: 我们只知道2000年时，厄休拉住在美国，而萨比娜和她的伴侣及两个孩子住在爱尔兰。

sentences.en: Nothing is really known about their lives though.
sentences.zh: 不过，关于她们的生活细节几乎一无所知。

sentences.en: From the year 2000 to the year 2008, it's believed that Sabina may have spent some time in the United States with Ursula.
sentences.zh: 据信，从2000年到2008年，萨比娜可能曾在美国与厄休拉住过一段时间。

sentences.en: And that her son even moved to the United States to live with Ursula for a period of time.
sentences.zh: 甚至她的儿子也曾搬到美国，和厄休拉住过一段时间。

sentences.en: For what reason, we don't know.
sentences.zh: 至于原因，我们不得而知。

sentences.en: There is no evidence that either Sabina or Ursula had been treated for mental health issues.
sentences.zh: 没有证据表明萨比娜或厄休拉曾因心理健康问题接受过治疗。

sentences.en: In 2008, Ursula visited Sabina in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 2008年，厄休拉前往爱尔兰探望萨比娜。

sentences.en: It's not known if this was just a catch-up visit or if there was a specific reason for the visit.
sentences.zh: 不知道这仅仅是一次叙旧，还是有特定的目的。

sentences.en: But what we do know is that during the visit, the twins were absolutely inseparable.
sentences.zh: 但我们确定的是，在那次探访期间，这对双胞胎形影不离。

sentences.en: They formed an extremely tight bond.
sentences.zh: 她们建立了极其紧密的联系。

sentences.en: And suddenly, in the early hours of the 16th of May 2008, without telling anyone of their intentions, Sabina and Ursula left Ireland.
sentences.zh: 突然，在2008年5月16日凌晨，萨比娜和厄休拉在未告知任何人的情况下离开了爱尔兰。

sentences.en: The twins were next seen the next day, the 17th of May, in Liverpool, England.
sentences.zh: 次日，即5月17日，有人在英国利物浦再次见到了这对双胞胎。

sentences.en: It's believed they travelled to England from Ireland via ferry.
sentences.zh: 据信她们是从爱尔兰乘渡轮前往英国的。

sentences.en: The twins entered St Anne Street Police Station in Liverpool and Sabina reported concerns about the safety of her children.
sentences.zh: 这对双胞胎走进了利物浦的圣安妮街警察局，萨比娜表达了对她孩子安全的担忧。

sentences.en: Why Sabina and Ursula travelled to England to report this, when the children and her partner were back in Ireland, is anyone's guess.
sentences.zh: 既然孩子和伴侣都在爱尔兰，为什么萨比娜和厄休拉要专门跑到英国来报案，这让人百思不得其解。

sentences.en: Liverpool Police contacted the police back in Ireland, who did a check on Sabina's partner and the children.
sentences.zh: 利物浦警方联系了爱尔兰警方，后者对萨比娜的伴侣和孩子进行了核查。

sentences.en: Everything was okay.
sentences.zh: 一切正常。

sentences.en: Sabina's partner told the Irish police that Sabina had taken off after they had a fight.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜的伴侣告诉爱尔兰警方，萨比娜是在他们吵架后离家出走的。

sentences.en: Irish police said Sabina and Ursula could get in touch with them if they had any fears or concerns upon their return to Ireland.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰警方表示，如果萨比娜和厄休拉回到爱尔兰后有任何恐惧或担忧，可以随时联系他们。

sentences.en: After leaving St Anne Street Police Station, the twins boarded a National Express coach that was headed for London.
sentences.zh: 离开圣安妮街警察局后，这对双胞胎登上了一辆开往伦敦的“国家快运”（National Express）长途客车。

sentences.en: They boarded the coach about 11.30am.
sentences.zh: 她们在上午11点30分左右上了车。

sentences.en: The twins each had a bag and they refused to put them in the baggage area of the coach.
sentences.zh: 这对双胞胎每人都有一个包，她们拒绝将其放入客车的行李舱。

sentences.en: They insisted on holding onto the bags.
sentences.zh: 她们坚持要随身携带这些包。

sentences.en: Just after 1pm, the coach stopped at Kill Services, which is a service station on the M6 motorway.
sentences.zh: 下午1点刚过，客车在M6高速公路上的基尔服务区（Kill Services）停靠。

sentences.en: Details of why the coach stopped are a bit sketchy.
sentences.zh: 关于客车停靠的原因，细节有些模糊。

sentences.en: There are reports that the coach stopped for a scheduled driver change.
sentences.zh: 有报道称客车是按计划停靠进行司机换班。

sentences.en: There's also reports saying that the only reason the coach stopped was because the twins were behaving erratically and causing trouble.
sentences.zh: 也有报道称客车停靠的唯一原因是这对双胞胎行为怪异，制造了麻烦。

sentences.en: Either way, the twins got off the coach, despite the fact it wasn't a scheduled rest stop.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，尽管这不是预定的休息站，这对双胞胎还是下了车。

sentences.en: The driver was suspicious of them and ended up refusing to allow them back on the coach because the twins wouldn't allow him to search their bags.
sentences.zh: 司机对她们产生了怀疑，最终拒绝让她们重新上车，因为她们不允许他检查她们的包。

sentences.en: The driver told the employee in the service station, Melissa Dutton, that he wasn't letting the twins back on,
sentences.zh: 司机告诉服务站员工梅丽莎·达顿（Melissa Dutton），他不会让这对双胞胎上车了，

sentences.en: and basically told her it was her problem now, she could look after it.
sentences.zh: 并基本上告诉她现在这是她的问题了，由她来处理。

sentences.en: So Melissa kept an eye on the twins as well.
sentences.zh: 于是梅丽莎也开始留意这对双胞胎。

sentences.en: She got suspicious of their behaviour.
sentences.zh: 她对她们的行为感到怀疑。

sentences.en: The twins were holding their bags tightly to their chest, like their lives were dependent on not letting go.
sentences.zh: 这对双胞胎紧紧地把包抱在胸前，仿佛她们的生命就系在这些包上，绝不能松手。

sentences.en: That, combined with the way they were talking and moving around, it looked like they were plotting something.
sentences.zh: 再加上她们说话和走动的方式，看起来她们像是在密谋什么。

sentences.en: Their behaviour actually led Melissa to think that maybe they were even carrying bombs in the bags.
sentences.zh: 她们的行为甚至让梅丽莎怀疑她们包里可能装着炸弹。

sentences.en: So Melissa called the police.
sentences.zh: 于是梅丽莎报了警。

sentences.en: Police did attend shortly after and spoke to the twins.
sentences.zh: 警方不久后赶到并与这对双胞胎进行了交谈。

sentences.en: But after checking them out, the officers didn't think anything was wrong.
sentences.zh: 但在检查过后，警官们认为没什么问题。

sentences.en: They told Melissa the twins were going to make their way to London and there were no issues.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉梅丽莎，这对双胞胎会自行前往伦敦，没有问题。

sentences.en: The police left the twins with a phone number for the coach company so they could arrange to get on the next coach.
sentences.zh: 警方给这对双胞胎留下了一个客车公司的电话号码，以便她们安排乘坐下一班车。

sentences.en: But instead of getting on another coach, the twins started walking along the M6 motorway.
sentences.zh: 但这对双胞胎没有去坐下一班车，而是开始沿着M6高速公路行走。

sentences.en: The M6 motorway is covered by video cameras, which are monitored at the Highway Agency's Control Centre in Birmingham.
sentences.zh: M6高速公路覆盖有视频监控，由伯明翰的高速公路管理局控制中心进行监控。

sentences.en: About 3.20pm, the twins were spotted on the cameras walking along the central reservation of the motorway.
sentences.zh: 下午3点20分左右，监控摄像头拍到这对双胞胎正沿着高速公路的中央隔离带行走。

sentences.en: There was a barrier on each side of them, but it was still dangerous.
sentences.zh: 虽然她们两侧都有护栏，但这依然非常危险。

sentences.en: Not a place for pedestrians.
sentences.zh: 那里根本不是行人该去的地方。

sentences.en: A Highway Agency patrol unit was dispatched to get the twins off the motorway.
sentences.zh: 高速公路管理局派出了一支巡逻队，试图将这对双胞胎带离高速公路。

sentences.en: Highway Agency officers aren't police.
sentences.zh: 高速公路管理局的官员不是警察。

sentences.en: Their role is to basically ensure there are no issues on the motorways.
sentences.zh: 他们的职责主要是确保高速公路上没有问题。

sentences.en: To ensure traffic is flowing freely and there are no incidents that could put anyone at risk.
sentences.zh: 确保交通畅通，没有可能危及任何人的事故发生。

sentences.en: If there is an accident, they will sort out the traffic management plan, put in roadblocks, diversions, things like that.
sentences.zh: 如果发生事故，他们会制定交通管理计划，设置路障、分流交通等。

sentences.en: They don't pull people over or issue speeding fines.
sentences.zh: 他们不会拦截车辆或开具超速罚单。

sentences.en: So a Highway Agency car was sent to get the twins out of the central reservation and off to safety.
sentences.zh: 因此，一辆高速公路管理局的车辆被派去将这对双胞胎从中央隔离带带到安全地带。

sentences.en: But when the twins saw the Highway Agency car, they jumped out of the central reservation and onto the motorway, in front of oncoming traffic.
sentences.zh: 但当这对双胞胎看到高速公路管理局的车时，她们跳出了中央隔离带，冲向了高速公路，直接挡在了迎面而来的车流前。

sentences.en: Cars had to brake hard and swerve to avoid running the twins over.
sentences.zh: 车辆不得不紧急刹车并急转弯，以避免撞上她们。

sentences.en: Sabina actually got clipped by a car and got knocked over.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜确实被一辆车擦撞并倒地。

sentences.en: The incident was captured on video.
sentences.zh: 这一幕被视频记录了下来。

sentences.en: Police and paramedics were immediately called to attend.
sentences.zh: 警方和医护人员立即被召集到现场。

sentences.en: The fear being Sabina could have serious injuries.
sentences.zh: 人们担心萨比娜可能受了重伤。

sentences.en: But she didn't.
sentences.zh: 但她并没有。

sentences.en: She was perfectly fine.
sentences.zh: 她安然无恙。

sentences.en: Her and Ursula made their way off the motorway and onto the shoulder.
sentences.zh: 她和厄休拉走下了高速公路，来到了路肩上。

sentences.en: Police officers Cope and Finlayson responded to the call.
sentences.zh: 科普警官和芬莱森警官响应了呼叫。

sentences.en: And it just so happened that they had a camera crew with them who were filming for BBC's television show, Motorway Cops.
sentences.zh: 碰巧的是，他们随行带着一个摄制组，正在为BBC的电视节目《高速公路警察》（Motorway Cops）进行拍摄。

sentences.en: When they arrived, the twins were still standing on the shoulder of the motorway.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达时，这对双胞胎仍站在高速公路的路肩上。

sentences.en: They were speaking with the two Highway Agency officers that first attended.
sentences.zh: 她们正在与先期到达的两名高速公路管理局官员交谈。

sentences.en: Everybody was calm and there were no issues at all.
sentences.zh: 每个人都很冷静，没有任何问题。

sentences.en: The paramedics hadn't arrived yet, but by the looks of it, they wouldn't be required.
sentences.zh: 医护人员还没到，但看起来似乎不需要他们了。

sentences.en: Everything was calm and cool, with no sign of anybody being injured.
sentences.zh: 一切都很平静，没有任何人受伤的迹象。

sentences.en: Officers Cope and Finlayson started talking with one of the Highway Agency officers to find out what was going on.
sentences.zh: 科普警官和芬莱森警官开始与其中一名高速公路管理局官员交谈，了解发生了什么。

sentences.en: The twins were a short distance away, standing next to the other Highway Agency officer.
sentences.zh: 这对双胞胎站在不远处，站在另一名高速公路管理局官员旁边。

sentences.en: Everybody was still standing on the motorway's shoulder.
sentences.zh: 大家依然站在高速公路的路肩上。

sentences.en: Whilst the Highway Agency officer was still briefing the police, this happened.
sentences.zh: 就在高速公路管理局官员向警方汇报情况时，发生了这一幕。

sentences.en: Right, what we've got, there's anyone in the central res.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们现在的情况是，有人在中央隔离带里。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: You know.
sentences.zh: 你懂的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Are they speak English?
sentences.zh: 她们会说英语吗？

sentences.en: Speak, one speaks English, I hear.
sentences.zh: 说话，有一个会说英语，我听到了。

sentences.en: The one in the red.
sentences.zh: 穿红衣服的那个。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We had a block coming up.
sentences.zh: 我们本来要封路的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Because we knew they were on camera.
sentences.zh: 因为我们知道她们在监控里。

sentences.en: A full closure?
sentences.zh: 全面封锁？

sentences.en: We were on camera.
sentences.zh: 我们在监控里看到了。

sentences.en: We'll close your door.
sentences.zh: 我们要关上你的车门。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: They were trying to cross the Bravo.
sentences.zh: 她们试图穿过Bravo车道。

sentences.en: So as we approached, they did, they hadn't seen us, by the end.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们靠近时，她们还没看到我们，直到最后。

sentences.en: The red one's got knocked down by the red tail over there.
sentences.zh: 穿红衣服的那个被那边的红色车撞倒了。

sentences.en: But an ambulance on route for her.
sentences.zh: 但救护车已经在赶往那里的路上了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Seems alright, but I'm not a doctor.
sentences.zh: 看起来还好，但我不是医生。

sentences.en: She has been knocked down by the other one.
sentences.zh: 她被另一个人撞倒了。

sentences.en: Is she the one that speaks English, or the other one?
sentences.zh: 她是那个会说英语的，还是另一个？

sentences.en: The other one?
sentences.zh: 另一个？

sentences.en: She's coming running.
sentences.zh: 她跑过来了。

sentences.en: Oh no!
sentences.zh: 噢，不！

sentences.en: My calmer, my calmer, we need ambulance.
sentences.zh: 我的天，我的天，我们需要救护车。

sentences.en: Senior officers to the scene, we've got two possible facels.
sentences.zh: 高级警官到现场，我们有两名可能的伤亡者。

sentences.en: The twins were standing there calmly, nothing seemed out of the ordinary at all.
sentences.zh: 这对双胞胎平静地站在那里，一切看起来都很正常。

sentences.en: Then suddenly, for no apparent reason, Ursula walked out onto the motorway.
sentences.zh: 突然，毫无征兆地，厄休拉走上了高速公路。

sentences.en: The highway agency officer nearby did his best, but he only managed to grab hold of a jacket, which she easily slipped out of.
sentences.zh: 附近的高速公路管理局官员尽了最大努力，但他只抓住了她的外套，她轻易地从外套里挣脱了。

sentences.en: Ursula ran straight onto the road, and directly into the side of a 40 tonne truck.
sentences.zh: 厄休拉径直冲向马路，直接撞上了一辆40吨重型卡车的侧面。

sentences.en: The truck ran straight over the top of her.
sentences.zh: 卡车直接从她身上碾了过去。

sentences.en: Sabina then made her move, running out onto the motorway as well.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜随后也采取了行动，跑向了高速公路。

sentences.en: She threw herself into the path of an oncoming car.
sentences.zh: 她把自己扔向了一辆迎面驶来的汽车。

sentences.en: She went straight over the front of the car, smashing into the windscreen, denting the bonnet and the roof, before being flung up into the air,
sentences.zh: 她直接撞上车头，砸碎了挡风玻璃，撞凹了引擎盖和车顶，随后被抛向空中，

sentences.en: and then slamming hard onto the road.
sentences.zh: 然后重重地摔在马路上。

sentences.en: It's incredible footage.
sentences.zh: 那段录像令人难以置信。

sentences.en: A link will be available in the show notes so you can see it.
sentences.zh: 节目说明中会提供链接，你可以观看。

sentences.en: Your initial response is that there is no chance they would have survived that.
sentences.zh: 你的第一反应是她们绝无生还可能。

sentences.en: But by some miracle, they both did.
sentences.zh: 但奇迹般的是，她们都活了下来。

sentences.en: Both of them laid motionless on the road, knocked unconscious by the impacts.
sentences.zh: 两人都瘫倒在马路上，因撞击而失去了知觉。

sentences.en: But they were alive.
sentences.zh: 但她们还活着。

sentences.en: The motorway was immediately shut down, and police went to work trying to render aid, while still waiting for the paramedics to arrive.
sentences.zh: 高速公路立即被封闭，警方开始工作试图提供援助，同时等待医护人员到达。

sentences.en: Oscar Tanger 33 on arrival.
sentences.zh: Oscar Tanger 33到达现场。

sentences.en: Both females have run out into the carriageway.
sentences.zh: 两名女性跑进了车道。

sentences.en: First female has been hit by a HGV in lane 2, serious injury.
sentences.zh: 第一名女性在2号车道被一辆重型货车撞倒，伤势严重。

sentences.en: Second female has been hit by a normal vehicle in lane 1.
sentences.zh: 第二名女性在1号车道被一辆普通车辆撞倒。

sentences.en: It's got two serious casualties.

sentences.zh: 格伦和彼得走过去，和她攀谈起来。

sentences.en: Sabina mentioned to them that her sister was in hospital and that she was trying to find her.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜向他们提到她姐姐在医院，她正试图找到她。

sentences.en: The conversation went on a little further before Sabina said she needed to find a bed and breakfast to stay at.
sentences.zh: 谈话继续了一会儿，萨比娜说她需要找一家民宿住下。

sentences.en: Glenn told her there was really nowhere around the area where she could stay.
sentences.zh: 格伦告诉她这附近确实没有可以住的地方。

sentences.en: But she was welcomed to go back to his house.
sentences.zh: 但他欢迎她去他家。

sentences.en: He said he would give her something to eat and then they could try and work out where her sister was and then they could organise somewhere for her to stay.
sentences.zh: 他说他会给她找点吃的，然后他们可以试着查清楚她姐姐在哪里，再帮她安排住处。

sentences.en: Peter says this was just in Glenn's character.
sentences.zh: 彼得说这正是格伦的性格。

sentences.en: He was a good Samaritan and liked to help people in need.
sentences.zh: 他是个乐善好施的人，喜欢帮助有需要的人。

sentences.en: He was a very warm and friendly type of person.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常热情友好的人。

sentences.en: Sabina accepted the offer.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜接受了邀请。

sentences.en: She then seemed to open up a bit more and become warmer and friendlier.
sentences.zh: 她随后似乎敞开了些，变得更热情、更友好了。

sentences.en: They got back to Glenn's house and sat down and had a few drinks together.
sentences.zh: 他们回到格伦家，坐下来一起喝了几杯。

sentences.en: When Glenn and Peter asked about Sabina's sister, her demeanour would change.
sentences.zh: 当格伦和彼得问起萨比娜的姐姐时，她的神情就会发生变化。

sentences.en: There would either be an awkward silence or she would quickly change the subject.
sentences.zh: 要么会出现尴尬的沉默，要么她会迅速转移话题。

sentences.en: Sabina also started to display some odd paranoid behaviour.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜也开始表现出一些奇怪的偏执行为。

sentences.en: They would be sitting down talking and then she would get up and walk over to the window, pull the shades up, stare up and down the street before snapping the shades back
sentences.zh: 他们坐着聊天时，她会突然起身走到窗边，拉起窗帘，盯着街上上下看，然后猛地拉上窗帘，

sentences.en: and sitting down again.
sentences.zh: 又坐回原处。

sentences.en: She did this a few times as if she was paranoid somebody was watching.
sentences.zh: 她这样做了几次，好像偏执地认为有人在监视她。

sentences.en: Then she got out her cigarettes and asked Glenn and Peter if they wanted one.
sentences.zh: 然后她拿出香烟，问格伦和彼得要不要来一根。

sentences.en: They both accepted.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都接受了。

sentences.en: As they were both about to light up,
sentences.zh: 就在他们准备点火时，

sentences.en: Sabina quickly snatched the cigarettes back off them and said, they might be poisoned, you can't have them.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜迅速把香烟从他们手中夺回，说，这些可能有毒，你们不能抽。

sentences.en: Despite the fact Sabina had been smoking from this particular packet of cigarettes all night.
sentences.zh: 尽管萨比娜整晚都在抽这包香烟。

sentences.en: Peter was starting to feel very uneasy.
sentences.zh: 彼得开始感到非常不安。

sentences.en: He could tell something wasn't quite right with Sabina.
sentences.zh: 他看得出萨比娜有点不对劲。

sentences.en: Glenn, on the other hand, didn't seem concerned at all.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，格伦似乎一点也不担心。

sentences.en: He was kicking back, relaxed and comfortable.
sentences.zh: 他靠在椅背上，放松而舒适。

sentences.en: He kept telling Peter not to worry, saying Sabina was just a bit quirky, nothing to be concerned about.
sentences.zh: 他一直告诉彼得不用担心，说萨比娜只是有点古怪，没什么好担心的。

sentences.en: But Peter couldn't get out of there soon enough.
sentences.zh: 但彼得只想尽快离开那里。

sentences.en: He left the house and went home, leaving Sabina and Glenn there by themselves.
sentences.zh: 他离开了房子回家了，留下萨比娜和格伦独自在那里。

sentences.en: Perhaps what was most intriguing is that despite being run over by a car, flung up into the air and slamming onto the road, two heavy impacts knocking her unconscious
sentences.zh: 也许最令人费解的是，尽管两天前刚被车撞倒，被抛向空中又重重摔在路上，两次猛烈撞击导致她失去知觉，

sentences.en: only two days before,
sentences.zh: 仅仅两天前，

sentences.en: Sabina wasn't complaining of any pain at all.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜却一点也没抱怨疼痛。

sentences.en: She seemed completely unaffected.
sentences.zh: 她看起来完全没受影响。

sentences.en: Around lunchtime the next day,
sentences.zh: 第二天午餐时间左右，

sentences.en: Glenn rung his brother Paul, who worked at the local hospital.
sentences.zh: 格伦给在当地医院工作的弟弟保罗打了电话。

sentences.en: He was trying to find out some more information on Ursula.
sentences.zh: 他试图了解更多关于厄休拉的信息。

sentences.en: Paul said Glenn was his usual cheerful self, no alarm bells at all.
sentences.zh: 保罗说格伦和平时一样开朗，完全没有警觉。

sentences.en: He could hear Sabina's voice in the background.
sentences.zh: 他能听到背景里有萨比娜的声音。

sentences.en: Glenn explained to his brother what had happened and said they were just after any information they could get on Ursula.
sentences.zh: 格伦向弟弟解释了发生的事情，并说他们只是想获取任何关于厄休拉的信息。

sentences.en: About 7.40pm that evening,
sentences.zh: 那天晚上大约7点40分，

sentences.en: Glenn walked outside and asked a neighbour, Frank Booth, if he had any spare tea bags.
sentences.zh: 格伦走到外面，问邻居弗兰克·布斯有没有多余的茶包。

sentences.en: Frank was outside washing his vehicle and told Glenn that when he finished up, he would go in and grab some.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克正在外面洗车，告诉格伦等他忙完就进去拿一些。

sentences.en: Glenn thanked him and walked back inside his house.
sentences.zh: 格伦道谢后走回屋里。

sentences.en: But only one minute later, he was back outside, staggering, suffering from four stab wounds, including one to the heart.
sentences.zh: 但仅仅一分钟后，他又踉跄着跑了出来，身上有四处刀伤，包括心脏部位的一处。

sentences.en: He said to Frank,
sentences.zh: 他对弗兰克说，

sentences.en: I've been stabbed.
sentences.zh: 我被捅了。

sentences.en: She stabbed me.
sentences.zh: 她捅了我。

sentences.en: He then collapsed to the ground.
sentences.zh: 随后他瘫倒在地。

sentences.en: Frank immediately dialled emergency services, which is triple nine in the UK.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克立即拨打了紧急服务电话，即英国的999。

sentences.en: As this was happening,
sentences.zh: 就在这时，

sentences.en: Glenn asked Frank to look after his dog.
sentences.zh: 格伦请求弗兰克照顾他的狗。

sentences.en: He then passed away.
sentences.zh: 然后他就去世了。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Sabina left Glenn's house and ran up the street carrying a hammer.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，萨比娜离开格伦家，拿着一把锤子跑上街。

sentences.en: She was in a completely deranged state, hitting herself over the head with the hammer.
sentences.zh: 她处于一种完全疯狂的状态，用锤子猛击自己的头部。

sentences.en: This caught the attention of a passing motorist, Joshua, who saw what she was doing and saw that her hair was matted with blood.
sentences.zh: 这引起了一位路过的司机约书亚的注意，他看到了她的所作所为，并看到她的头发被血粘在一起。

sentences.en: She also had blood over the front of her jacket.
sentences.zh: 她的夹克前襟也沾满了血。

sentences.en: Joshua got out of his car and tried to wrestle the hammer from Sabina.
sentences.zh: 约书亚下车试图从萨比娜手中夺下锤子。

sentences.en: Sabina struggled with him and seemed to be in an absolute rage.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜与他扭打在一起，似乎处于极度的愤怒中。

sentences.en: Sabina got the better of Joshua by hitting him in the back of the head with a broken piece of roof tile that she was carrying in her pocket.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜用口袋里藏着的一块破碎的瓦片击中约书亚的后脑勺，占了上风。

sentences.en: Sabina got away.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜逃脱了。

sentences.en: Joshua saw two paramedic vehicles driving after her.
sentences.zh: 约书亚看到两辆救护车追赶着她。

sentences.en: They had obviously responded to the call and driven across Sabina.
sentences.zh: 他们显然是接到了报警并开车经过萨比娜身边。

sentences.en: Sabina continued running, trying to get away from the paramedics.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜继续奔跑，试图摆脱医护人员。

sentences.en: She ran to a bridge at Heron Cross above the A50 roadway.
sentences.zh: 她跑向赫伦十字路口上方A50公路的一座桥上。

sentences.en: Sabina climbed the railing and jumped straight off onto the road below.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜爬上栏杆，直接跳到了下方的公路上。

sentences.en: The fall was about 30 feet, which is about 10 metres.
sentences.zh: 坠落高度约30英尺，即约10米。

sentences.en: She broke both of her ankles and fractured her skull.
sentences.zh: 她双脚踝骨折，颅骨骨裂。

sentences.en: But again, she survived.
sentences.zh: 但她再次活了下来。

sentences.en: She was transported to hospital for treatment.
sentences.zh: 她被送往医院接受治疗。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, police examined the crime scene at Glenn's house.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，警方检查了格伦家的犯罪现场。

sentences.en: It looked as though Glenn was in the process of preparing a meal when he had been stabbed.
sentences.zh: 看起来格伦在被捅时正在准备饭菜。

sentences.en: Sabina's DNA profile was found on the kitchen knife used to stab Glenn.
sentences.zh: 在用于捅伤格伦的厨房刀具上发现了萨比娜的DNA图谱。

sentences.en: Her bloodstained jacket and a ring she was wearing contained matching DNA from Glenn.
sentences.zh: 她沾满血迹的夹克和她戴的一枚戒指上含有与格伦相匹配的DNA。

sentences.en: Sabina remained in hospital until September.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜一直在医院待到九月。

sentences.en: Upon being discharged from hospital, she was charged with the murder of Glenn Hollenshead.
sentences.zh: 出院后，她被指控谋杀格伦·霍伦斯黑德。

sentences.en: Ursula was also discharged from hospital in September, but she wasn't charged with any offences.
sentences.zh: 厄休拉也在九月出院，但她没有被指控任何罪行。

sentences.en: She was allowed to return to Sweden.
sentences.zh: 她被允许返回瑞典。

sentences.en: Sabina refused to answer any questions at all.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜拒绝回答任何问题。

sentences.en: Every question that was asked of her, she replied, no comment.
sentences.zh: 对于问她的每一个问题，她都回答“无可奉告”。

sentences.en: So we have no idea exactly what happened in Glenn's house that day or even the night before after Peter had left.
sentences.zh: 所以我们完全不知道那天在格伦家，或者在彼得离开后的前一天晚上到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Sabina pleaded not guilty to murder and a trial date was set for February 2009, but it was postponed due to issues getting Sabina's medical records.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜对谋杀指控表示不认罪，审判日期定于2009年2月，但由于获取萨比娜医疗记录的问题而被推迟。

sentences.en: The trial was rescheduled for September 2009,
sentences.zh: 审判重新安排在2009年9月，

sentences.en: but the case never ended up going to trial.
sentences.zh: 但案件最终没有进入审判阶段。

sentences.en: Instead, she was able to plead guilty to a lesser charge.
sentences.zh: 相反，她得以对较轻的指控认罪。

sentences.en: Prior to the trial,
sentences.zh: 在审判前，

sentences.en: Sabina was assessed by two forensic psychiatrists, one acting for the defence and the other one acting for the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜接受了两名法医精神病学家的评估，一名代表辩方，另一名代表控方。

sentences.en: They both reached the same conclusion.
sentences.zh: 他们得出了相同的结论。

sentences.en: Sabina was mentally ill at the time she killed Glenn Holland's head, but they had different opinions on what the mental illness was.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜在杀害格伦·霍伦斯黑德时患有精神疾病，但他们对具体是什么精神疾病有不同意见。

sentences.en: The defence diagnosed Sabina with induced delusional disorder.
sentences.zh: 辩方诊断萨比娜患有感应性妄想症。

sentences.en: A basic meaning is madness in two people.
sentences.zh: 基本含义就是两人共同疯狂。

sentences.en: So what they were saying is that one person suffers from a psychotic illness and then the second person becomes affected by it and they end up taking on the psychosis as well.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说的是，一个人患有精神病，然后第二个人受到影响，最终也染上了这种精神病。

sentences.en: For example,
sentences.zh: 例如，

sentences.en: Ursula runs out onto the motorway into the path of a truck.
sentences.zh: 厄休拉冲上高速公路，跑进卡车的行驶路径。

sentences.en: So Sabina follows.
sentences.zh: 于是萨比娜也跟着做了。

sentences.en: Both conditions were extremely rare and Glenn's family wanted to know why Sabina was released from hospital so soon and allowed to go free after the motorway incident
sentences.zh: 这两种情况都极为罕见，格伦的家人想知道，如果萨比娜当时被认定患有精神病发作，为什么她在高速公路事件后这么快就从医院获释并被允许重获自由。

sentences.en: if she was suffering from what was now determined to be a psychotic episode.
sentences.zh: 如果她当时确实患有现在所确定的精神病发作。

sentences.en: Prior to Sabina's release from hospital after the motorway incident, she was seen by a police surgeon, a psychiatrist and a social worker.
sentences.zh: 在高速公路事件后萨比娜从医院获释前，她曾接受过警医、精神科医生和社会工作者的检查。

sentences.en: These aren't police officers, they are medical professionals and they all came to the conclusion that Sabina displayed no obvious signs of any mental or psychological illness.
sentences.zh: 他们不是警察，而是医疗专业人员，他们都得出结论，萨比娜没有表现出任何明显的精神或心理疾病迹象。

sentences.en: They all concluded she was fit and well to be released.
sentences.zh: 他们都认为她身体健康，可以获释。

sentences.en: They didn't have the benefit of seeing the footage when they came to that conclusion, but they would have had detailed accounts from the officers who were there of what went on.
sentences.zh: 他们在得出该结论时没有看过录像，但他们应该已经从当时在场的警官那里得到了关于所发生事情的详细描述。

sentences.en: It's pretty amazing that they did come to that conclusion.
sentences.zh: 他们竟然得出那样的结论，真是令人惊讶。

sentences.en: A couple of explanations have been thrown up.
sentences.zh: 人们提出了几种解释。

sentences.en: If she was in fact suffering from a puff of madness, then the psychotic behaviour can come and go quickly.
sentences.zh: 如果她确实患有短暂的疯狂，那么精神病行为可能会迅速来去。

sentences.en: So it may have been gone momentarily at the time she was assessed.
sentences.zh: 所以当她接受评估时，这种症状可能暂时消失了。

sentences.en: Another theory is that maybe the sedation she was given on the motorway was still having a bit of a calming effect on her at the time she was assessed.
sentences.zh: 另一种理论是，也许她在高速公路上被给予的镇静剂在接受评估时仍对她产生了一定的镇静作用。

sentences.en: Either way, the system failed.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，系统失败了。

sentences.en: The murder charge was dropped and Sabina was allowed to enter a plea of guilty to manslaughter on the grounds of diminished responsibility.
sentences.zh: 谋杀指控被撤销，萨比娜被允许以责任能力减弱为由承认过失杀人罪。

sentences.en: The judge accepting that Sabina had suffered from a rare and temporary form of insanity at the time of the murder.
sentences.zh: 法官接受了萨比娜在谋杀时患有一种罕见且暂时性精神错乱的说法。

sentences.en: During the court process,
sentences.zh: 在法庭审理过程中，

sentences.en: Sabina maintained a silence about what had happened.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜对所发生的事情保持沉默。

sentences.en: She didn't utter a single word about the murder of Glenn Hollandshead or the motorway incident.
sentences.zh: 她没有吐露关于谋杀格伦·霍伦斯黑德或高速公路事件的只言片语。

sentences.en: No one had any idea what the twins were even doing in England in the first place.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道这对双胞胎当初为什么会出现在英国。

sentences.en: They have never given a reason.
sentences.zh: 他们从未给出过理由。

sentences.en: The judge had a difficult time determining exactly what diagnosis of Sabina was the correct one as a strong case could be made for both.
sentences.zh: 法官很难确定萨比娜究竟患有哪种疾病，因为两种诊断都有充分的依据。

sentences.en: It was made more difficult by the fact that neither of the forensic psychiatrists had assessed Ursula.
sentences.zh: 更困难的是，两位法医精神科医生都没有对厄休拉进行过评估。

sentences.en: Maybe if she had been assessed, they could have gotten some piece of information that could have shed a bit more light on Pings.
sentences.zh: 如果她接受过评估，或许他们能获得一些信息，从而对平斯的情况有更多了解。

sentences.en: Another issue arose with the case when both the defence and the prosecution agreed that although
sentences.zh: 此案还出现了另一个问题，辩方和控方都同意，尽管

sentences.en: Sabina was mentally ill at the time of the murder, she had now made a full recovery.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜在谋杀时患有精神疾病，但她现在已经完全康复了。

sentences.en: So what that meant was that the judge couldn't send her to a secure mental health hospital
sentences.zh: 这意味着法官不能把她送进封闭式精神病院，

sentences.en: because she was no longer mentally ill.
sentences.zh: 因为她已经不再患有精神疾病了。

sentences.en: So instead, he wanted to give Sabina a sentence with no fixed release date to make sure she would only be freed when it was safe to do so.
sentences.zh: 因此，他想给萨比娜判处一个没有固定释放日期的刑期，以确保只有在安全的情况下才释放她。

sentences.en: But he could only do that if Sabina was considered a risk to the public.
sentences.zh: 但他只有在萨比娜被认为对公众构成威胁的情况下才能这样做。

sentences.en: And both the defence and the prosecution psychiatrists agreed that they considered
sentences.zh: 而辩方和控方的精神科医生都一致认为，他们认为

sentences.en: Sabina to only be a low risk.
sentences.zh: 萨比娜的风险很低。

sentences.en: With that, the judge said his hands were tied.
sentences.zh: 鉴于此，法官表示他束手无策。

sentences.en: Given she was determined to be low risk, by law, the judge had to give her a fixed-term prison sentence with no supervision or monitoring requirements after her release.
sentences.zh: 由于她被认定为低风险，根据法律，法官必须判处她有期徒刑，且释放后没有任何监管或监控要求。

sentences.en: He sentenced her to five years jail.
sentences.zh: 他判处她五年监禁。

sentences.en: Glenn's family considered Sabina's diagnosis to be a pretty convenient one.
sentences.zh: 格伦的家人认为萨比娜的诊断结果非常“方便”。

sentences.en: A quick and easy way to deal with the case because really, no one had any idea what was going on.
sentences.zh: 这是一种处理此案的简单快捷的方法，因为实际上，没人知道到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: It was so bizarre.
sentences.zh: 这太离奇了。

sentences.en: Here is what the judge,
sentences.zh: 以下是法官，

sentences.en: Justice Saunders, had to say at sentencing.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯法官在宣判时所说的话。

sentences.en: I understand that this sentence will seem entirely inadequate to the relatives of the deceased.
sentences.zh: 我理解对于死者亲属来说，这个判决显得完全不充分。

sentences.en: However, I have sentenced on the basis that the reason for the killing was the mental illness and therefore the culpability of the defendant was low.
sentences.zh: 然而，我的判决依据是，杀人的原因是精神疾病，因此被告的罪责较低。

sentences.en: And therefore, the sentence I have passed is designed to protect the public.
sentences.zh: 因此，我作出的判决旨在保护公众。

sentences.en: It is not designed to reflect the grief the relatives have suffered or to measure the value of Mr. Holland's head's life.
sentences.zh: 它并非旨在反映亲属所遭受的悲痛，也不是为了衡量霍兰德先生生命的价值。

sentences.en: No sentence that I could pass could do that.
